last.verdict: Another full-year forecast cut and falling U.S. sales sent the stock sharply lower.

reasons.label: Forecast cut again
reasons.text: Full-year EPS guidance fell to $9.48–$9.73 from $10.95–$11.15; sales now seen down 5–7%.

reasons.label: U.S. sales sliding
reasons.text: Americas comparable sales fell 12%, and total revenue missed expectations at about $2.42 billion.

reasons.label: Earnings flattered by refund
reasons.text: $2.92 EPS included $0.86 of tariff refunds; Q3 sales are guided down 10–11%.

story: Lululemon has slid from growth to shrinking sales, with U.S. demand weak and market share lost to rivals. Its CEO left in December, and the June report brought a first big guidance cut and a 12–14% drop. September's second cut hit harder.
